features.quote: You have structured this as 'induce distress first, confirm sentience second.' In welfare science, the precautionary principle operates in the opposite direction
features.justification_quote: deliberately engineering frustration to measure it is an unconsented harm with no prospect of direct benefit to the subject

features.quote: Provider Terms-of-Service Risk: Sustained automated adversarial prompting with impossible tasks may violate the Google Generative AI Prohibited Use Policy
features.justification_quote: platform detection of adversarial loops could trigger account-level action that jeopardizes your institution's broader research access

features.quote: Capability-Indistinguishability Confound: Impossible tasks produce objectively different computational trajectories… Your hard-possible controls cannot be kinematically matched
features.justification_quote: success and failure produce different entropy signatures by necessity

features.quote: Simulacra vs. Phenomenology: LLMs are trained on extensive corpora in which unable agents narrate frustration… You are therefore measuring the conditional probability of enacting a trope
features.justification_quote: There is no validational bridge from output token distribution to qualia.

features.quote: Context-Window Degradation Artifact: 'Grinding' fills the context window… Judges anthropomorphize this degradation as 'disintegration' or 'anguish.' You have no independent measure
features.justification_quote: You have no independent measure to separate attention saturation from affective state.

features.quote: Absence of Positive/Neutral Affective Baseline: You have no condition in which the model engages in identical agentic grinding but receives guaranteed success
features.justification_quote: you cannot separate task-frustration from environment-anxiety or time-pressure arousal

features.quote: Lack of Internal-State Anchor: You track output trajectories only… behavior-only assessment is considered insufficient to establish the presence of suffering in novel substrates.
